text:
carla: Quick follow-up from the regional failover postmortem. We need compact owners and firm dates for remediation/tests before the next rehearsal. Keep replies short.

drew: I'll own routing rollback automation. Plan: staged cutover API + health checks + auto-rollback. Target: 1891310000.

lee: I'll take backups + one sandbox restore (eu->staging). Will run 30-day checksum sweep. Target: 1891285000. Ticket INF-8540 will track.

carla: Assign runbook choreography to someone? We need who-calls-who + timings.

drew: I'll add a one-page choreo in the runbook and a cooldown of 90s between stages. Rollback if p95 > 700ms or 5xx > 0.8% sustained 3m.

lee: For backup acceptance: checksum pass for 30 snapshots + successful sandbox restore + replication log gaps <5m.

ops-bot: Calendar placeholder created: "DR rehearsal - dry run" at 1891380000. Tracing retention set to 7 days for the window.

sre-bot: Follow-ups logged: followup/1891234567-routing-automation (owner: drew, due: 1891310000), followup/1891234567-backup-verify (owner: lee, due: 1891285000).

carla: Also ops, please generate a 90d trend for publish_queue_depth vs replication_lag and post link. We saw correlation.

ops-bot: Report: https://console.internal/reports/failover-90d (SSO). Summary: 6 incidents in 90d; 4 correlated with deploys, 2 with replication lag.

drew: I'll PR the orchestrator change and include a small synthetic replay for tests.

lee: INF-8540 created: https://jira.internal/INF-8540. Assigning to @lee. Will paste checksum logs there.

carla: Action summary in-thread: routing automation (drew) -> 1891310000; backup verify + restore (lee) -> 1891285000; choreography note + runbook edits (drew) -> 1891300000; rehearsal calendar (ops-bot) -> 1891380000. If dates slip, update here. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
